# DeviantArt

> DeviantArt is the world's largest online art community and marketplace, hosting over 350 million artworks with tools for creation, discovery, and monetization.

DeviantArt serves as a comprehensive platform for digital artists, traditional artists, and art enthusiasts to share portfolios, participate in challenges, discover similar works, and access AI-powered creation tools like DreamUp. The platform combines social networking, e-commerce, and creative tools to support artists at all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Digital Art
- Artist Portfolios
- Character Design
- Fan Art
- Adoptables
- DreamUp AI Generator
- Art Marketplace
- Drawing Tutorials
- Fantasy Creatures
- Community Challenges
- Core Membership
- User-Generated Content
- Similar Art Discovery
- Art Gallery
- Oil Painting

## Core Platform

- [DeviantArt Homepage](https://www.deviantart.com): Main hub for the 350M+ artwork collection and global art community
- [User Registration](https://www.deviantart.com/join): Account signup with social login options for new community members
- [Core Membership](https://www.deviantart.com/core-membership/buy): Premium subscription unlocking DreamUp, Sta.sh cloud storage, and Protect features

## Creator Tools & Features

- [DreamUp AI Art Generator](https://www.deviantart.com/dreamup): AI-powered art generation tool with free tier access for community artists
- [Daily Challenges](https://www.deviantart.com/dailychallenges): Creative prompts and competitions encouraging daily art submissions and community engagement

## Art Marketplace

- [DeviantArt Shop](https://www.deviantart.com/shop): E-commerce marketplace for buying and selling digital art, adoptables, and illustrations

## Artist Portfolios & Galleries

- [Ker-by Artist Profile](https://www.deviantart.com/ker-by): Hobbyist digital artist portfolio featuring anime fan art and character designs
- [Wing Tutorial Guide](https://www.deviantart.com/ker-by/art/Wing-tutorial-1289996410): Comprehensive drawing guide tutorial for dragon wings and creature anatomy
- [DeLumine Artist Profile](https://www.deviantart.com/delumine): Professional artist portfolio with gallery, followers, and favorite collections
- [Oil Portrait - Andie](https://www.deviantart.com/delumine/art/Oil-Portrait-Andie-1300552644): Oil portrait artwork demonstrating impressionism and alla prima painting techniques
- [Grimmla Artist Profile](https://www.deviantart.com/grimmla): Professional digital artist specializing in dragons and fantasy creature design
- [Enfield Fantasy Creature](https://www.deviantart.com/grimmla/art/Enfield-1310846283): Fantasy creature design artwork featuring mythological Enfield character illustration
- [Cat-With-Horns Artist Profile](https://www.deviantart.com/cat-with-horns): Hobbyist digital artist portfolio featuring character art, adoptables, and digital paintings
- [Hunting Wildlife Painting](https://www.deviantart.com/cat-with-horns/art/Hunting-1298438738): Wildlife digital painting depicting penguin and leopard seal hunting interaction scene

## Discovery & Recommendations

- [Similar Art to Wing Tutorial](https://www.deviantart.com/morelikethis/1289996410): Recommendation engine surfacing similar wing tutorials and creature drawing guides
- [Similar Art to Oil Portrait](https://www.deviantart.com/morelikethis/1300552644): Similar artwork finder for portrait painting and figurative art recommendations
- [Similar Art to Enfield](https://www.deviantart.com/morelikethis/1310846283): Similar art discovery for fantasy creatures and gryphon digital illustrations
- [Similar Art to Hunting](https://www.deviantart.com/morelikethis/1298438738): Similar art search engine for hunting themes and wildlife artwork recommendations
